baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction يَوْمَ يَفِرُّ ... مِنْ أَخِيهِ joins an event-time, an active departure, a singular person, and separation from a brother.
baseline_models.mechanism: The day is available as a severe occurrence rather than a neutral calendar unit; within it, a person converts the nearest peer-kin relation into the source from which escape is made.

activation_trace.role: A day as a severe event turns the temporal frame into the pressure generating the scene.
Literal flight supplies the outward motion and the search for separation or refuge.
The generic human individual makes the collapse of relation apply at the level of any person.
Brotherhood and kinship make the escaped-from figure a normally intimate ally rather than a random threat.

changed_reading.before: A date is named on which someone runs away from a sibling.
changed_reading.after: A severe occurrence reorganizes intimacy itself: the person survives the pressure by making his brother the point of separation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The prepositional phrase مِنْ أَخِيهِ attaches the motion of يَفِرُّ directly to the brother-root's bond inventory.
baseline_models.mechanism: The brother is not only a relative but a tether, protected obligation, or covenantal claim. Flight therefore moves away from what binds and can demand a response.

activation_trace.role: Escape supplies deliberate distance from a constraining source.
The tether-loop, protected bond, and obligation make brotherhood function as a claim that holds the person in relation.
The individual person is the bearer who attempts to exit that binding claim.

changed_reading.before: The brother is merely the nearest frightening person.
changed_reading.after: The person flees the brother as a binding claim: what is escaped is the relation's hold and its demand, not simply the relative's presence.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The verb يَفِرُّ carries a branch of probing, uncovering, and drawing out what is hidden, while the flight remains syntactically directed away from a brother.
baseline_models.mechanism: An attempt to remove oneself from the closest relational witness becomes an involuntary probe: the direction of flight discloses what the person values or fears.

activation_trace.role: Uncovering, inspection, and eliciting hidden contents make the visible act diagnostic of an interior state.
The person is both the actor who flees and the hidden subject thereby exposed.
Close kinship raises the evidentiary force of turning away: the abandoned relation reveals the actor.

changed_reading.before: Flight conceals the person by removing him from the scene.
changed_reading.after: Flight paradoxically exposes the person: whom he abandons under pressure draws his hidden ordering of claims into view.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The noun ٱلْمَرْءُ is activated beside a branch of م ر ء naming complete human virtue, while أَخِيهِ supplies brotherhood and obligation.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse can stage an ethical inversion inside the word for person: the figure grammatically called the person abandons the bond through which humane virtue would normally be enacted.

activation_trace.role: The branch of mature human virtue supplies the ethical capacity placed under pressure.
The protected tether makes care for the brother a concrete test of that capacity.
Flight enacts the collapse or suspension of relational virtue rather than merely describing fear.

changed_reading.before: A human being performs an understandable act of escape.
changed_reading.after: The word for person carries a latent standard of humane character that the flight from a binding brother dramatically suspends.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The event-day frames يَفِرُّ, whose inventory includes a return of an affair or age to its beginning, before the person separates from brotherhood.
baseline_models.mechanism: The severe event can reset the socially constituted person to a bare individual, reversing the accumulated relation represented by brotherhood.

activation_trace.role: The severe occurrence supplies reset-level pressure rather than ordinary elapsed time.
A matter returning to its beginning supplies the reversal from social formation toward bare origin.
The singular person is the residual unit after relational identities are stripped away.
Brotherhood supplies the acquired social layer from which the reset retreats.

changed_reading.before: The person moves forward and away from danger.
changed_reading.after: The event also drives a reversal toward a pre-social beginning, leaving the named person without the brotherhood that helped constitute him.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening frown-root contains a harsh-day branch. It seeds a scale-change from one contracted face and act of aversion to the severe event-day in which relational withdrawal becomes universal.

activation_trace.role: A harsh, repellent day latent in the opening frown-root prefigures the focus day as an event of aversion.
The focus day receives that severity and expands it from a facial incident into an encompassing occurrence.
Flight scales the initial local aversion into complete bodily withdrawal.

structural_cues: The surah opens with a face contracting and a person turning away, while 80:34 opens with the marked day and another withdrawal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the frown-root's harsh-day image and the focus event-day; I infer that the first aversion is magnified into the later universal scene. The live alternative is lexical foreshadowing without a causal scale-change.

changed_reading.before: The focus day arrives as an unrelated eschatological timestamp.
changed_reading.after: The day is the maximal form of the opening frown: a local contraction of welcome has become an event-wide contraction of human relation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening sequence repeatedly opposes an exposed person's coming and purposeful striving to another person's turning away and becoming occupied elsewhere. The focus recasts that asymmetry as direct flight from a claim-bearing brother.

activation_trace.role: Flight is the intensified away-vector that completes the earlier geometry.
The tethered obligation turns the escaped-from person into a claimant on relation.
Turning the back and withdrawing supplies the first away-vector.
Arrival supplies a vulnerable other's movement into relational range.
Purposeful movement toward a sought end makes the approach intentional rather than accidental.
Being occupied by something else supplies the attentional mechanism behind bodily turning away.

structural_cues: 80:1-10 alternates coming or striving toward someone with turning or attending away from him.
The focus changes an implicit away-vector into the explicit construction يَفِرُّ ... مِنْ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed motions and diverted attention; I infer that the focus universalizes their relational mechanism. The alternative is that the early encounter and later flight share posture but not moral or causal continuity.

changed_reading.before: The flight is generated only by the focus day's terror.
changed_reading.after: The flight is also the terminal form of a practiced relational geometry: a claimant comes near, attention shifts elsewhere, the body turns, and finally the person runs from the bond.

context_deltas.mechanism: Creation, death, and reanimation make the focus occur after a full restart of embodied existence. That sequence activates the flight-root's return-to-the-beginning branch as a social reset, not merely locomotion.

activation_trace.role: Return to an affair's beginning supplies the reset image carried into the revived person's flight.
Brotherhood is the social formation that the reset appears to undo.
Originary creation establishes the first beginning to which the sequence can return.
Loss of life and power breaks the continuity of the first embodied course.
Reviving the dead supplies the literal restart immediately presupposed by the later event scene.

structural_cues: 80:18-22 runs from creation through measured life, death, burial, and revival before the focus scene.
The revived subject is again called a singular person when relation begins to fall away.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit life-cycle restart and a focus branch for return to the beginning; I infer that bodily restart triggers social de-layering. The live alternative retains resurrection as setting and reads يَفِرُّ only as forward escape.

changed_reading.before: A resurrected person simply runs from a relative.
changed_reading.after: Resurrection reopens the person's beginning, and the first visible effect is a pre-social reset in which even brotherhood no longer organizes the self.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earth is forcefully opened and that fissure produces growth; the focus flight-root also contains tearing and splitting, but its object is a tethered human relation. The two openings coexist as productive material rupture and sterile social rupture.

activation_trace.role: Physical shaking, tearing, and splitting lets flight be felt as a rupture rather than only a change of location.
The tether image supplies the social material being torn.
The earth's repeated cleaving supplies a visible, forceful opening against which relational splitting can be compared.
Growth emerging from earth marks that earlier rupture as generative, sharpening the focus rupture's barrenness.

structural_cues: The cognate repetition in 80:26 dwells on opening the earth, followed immediately by growth and food.
The focus uses مِنْ to mark a human separation but names no product of that separation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two branch-backed kinds of splitting and makes one produce nourishment; I supply the contrastive arrow that the social tear produces isolation. The alternative is parallel intensity without an intended productive-versus-sterile contrast.

changed_reading.before: Flight is a neutral trajectory away from a brother.
changed_reading.after: Flight rends a relational tether: unlike the opened earth, which yields sustenance, this opening yields a person isolated from kin.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding event does not merely exist on a date; it comes upon the scene, and the arrival-root's compulsion branch makes the focus day an agent-like force that drives flight.

activation_trace.role: Arrival as forcing or necessitation supplies the directional pressure from event to flight.
The severe-event sense receives the arriving force and makes the day itself the operative occurrence.
Flight is the bodily result inferred from that coercive arrival.

structural_cues: The threshold فَإِذَا in 80:33 leads directly into يَوْمَ يَفِرُّ in 80:34.
The branchless root ص خ خ in 80:33 remains only a structural cue: its named event is the grammatical subject that arrives.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies event-arrival, an arrival branch of compulsion, and immediate flight; I infer the arrow arrival forces flight. The alternative is that arrival only establishes time while the cause remains unspecified terror.

changed_reading.before: The day passively contains an episode of flight.
changed_reading.after: An event arrives with coercive force and actively drives the person out of the relational bonds named after it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The brother's tether is followed by relations of origin and nurture, chosen or sustained companionship, and descendant lineage. Flight initiates a systematic dismantling of the structures by which the person is held, accompanied, and extended.

activation_trace.role: Flight initiates the serial movement away from the relational architecture.
The brother as tether and protected obligation provides the first structural bond.
Motherhood and nurture supply embodied origin and first care.
Fatherhood and upbringing add a second origin-and-care relation.
Companionship and sustained proximity supply the adult lateral bond.
Filiation and derivation from an origin supply the person's extension into descendants.

structural_cues: 80:34-36 coordinates brother, mother, father, companion, and sons under the flight verb's continuing syntax.
Repeated possessive suffixes keep every relation attached to the same fleeing person even as each attachment is named and left.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies distinct relational branch functions and serial coordination; I infer an architecture ordered across peer, origin, companion, and descendant bonds. The alternative is an exhaustive panic list with no internal topology.

changed_reading.before: The brother is one example in a list of people avoided during panic.
changed_reading.after: The brother is the first tether in a staged deconstruction of personhood's whole relational architecture, from origins through companionship to continuation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next verse repeats the person and assigns every one a complete private affair whose sufficiency absorbs him. This revises the cause of flight from simple fear to total occupation by one's own claim, which disables response to another's tethered claim.

activation_trace.role: Flight becomes the outward behavior produced by exclusive inward occupation.
The brother's tethered claim is what private sufficiency renders temporarily inoperative.
Sufficiency supplies a closed economy in which one's own affair leaves no capacity for another.
Totality and encompassing completion distribute that closure to every person.
The repeated person-noun explicitly carries the focus actor into the explanatory sentence.
A private affair or pressing condition supplies the content that fills the person's attention.

structural_cues: 80:37 follows the coordinated kin list as an explanatory generalization beginning لِكُلِّ ٱمْرِئٍ.
The same person-root appears in 80:34 and 80:37, linking actor and explanation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies totality, repeated personhood, a private affair, and sufficiency; I infer that private sufficiency blocks responsiveness to kin. A live alternative hears يُغْنِيهِ as preoccupation rather than independence, though both produce attentional closure.

changed_reading.before: The person escapes because relatives themselves add danger or demands.
changed_reading.after: His own affair becomes a self-sufficing field that consumes all response-capacity; flight is the bodily expression of a temporarily closed personal economy.

context_deltas.mechanism: Written sheets and agents whose root can disclose writing precede faces described through the same disclosure-root. The focus flight-root's probing branch makes the act itself write or uncover an interior ordering that the later face presents as a readable surface.

activation_trace.role: Probing and exposing hidden contents make the flight an evidentiary act.
The written sheet establishes durable, legible inscription as an earlier mode of disclosure.
A book that reveals what is written links the agents of the sheets to the mechanism of legibility.
Removing a covering makes the later face an opened surface rather than a private interior.
The face and forward-facing surface provide the bodily page on which outcome appears.
Facial expansion and visible teeth make one class of result publicly readable.
The revealed skin or outer surface reinforces the movement of inner state onto exterior form.

structural_cues: The sheets, hands, and agents of 80:13-16 establish a record complex before the human sequence.
After the flight and its explanation, 80:38-41 classify people by what appears on their faces.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies writing, disclosure, and facial-surface branches; I infer a transfer of legibility from sheet to act to face. The alternative is that records and faces disclose independently without making the flight itself inscription-like.

changed_reading.before: Flight is a private survival action whose meaning remains inside the actor.
changed_reading.after: Flight opens and effectively records the actor's ordering of claims; the later face is the public surface on which that disclosed interior becomes legible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The person departs, but the later dark-face sequence supplies what remains after departure, what catches up and overwhelms, and what constricts. Flight creates distance from kin without creating distance from consequence.

activation_trace.role: Escape establishes a forward motion that the later images can follow and defeat.
A remainder persisting after what accompanied it has gone supplies the trace that flight leaves behind.
Drawing near and catching up turns the facial covering into a pursuing consequence.
Overwhelming and subduing complete the failure of attempted escape.
Constriction closes the space that flight tried to open.

structural_cues: Active flight in 80:34 is followed by static faces in 80:40 and then an active predicate of something overtaking them in 80:41.
The covering is said to be upon the faces, reversing the fugitive's attempt to leave something behind.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies departure, persistent remainder, catching-up, overpowering, and constriction; I arrange them as a pursuit arrow. The alternative reads the later facial predicates as static verdicts unrelated to the earlier movement.

changed_reading.before: Flight succeeds at least in making space between the person and his brother.
changed_reading.after: The person can leave kin behind, but not the residue of that departure: it catches him, covers the face, and constricts the space he tried to gain.

context_deltas.mechanism: The human section is framed by covering and ends with covering plus breach. Against that frame, the focus flight-root's exposure branch makes escape paradoxical: leaving the brother's bond attempts concealment but visibly breaches it.

activation_trace.role: Exposure and elicitation make attempted evasion disclose the actor's covered interior.
The protected tether supplies the boundary whose rupture becomes visible.
Covering a benefit supplies the earlier hidden refusal within the human's relation to what sustains him.
Covering or blocking truth supplies the final classification's concealment pole.
Deviation and tearing a protective veil supply the breach pole exposed by abandoning the bond.

structural_cues: 80:17 opens the human sequence with an intensified ك ف ر form, and 80:42 closes the surah by pairing ك ف ر and ف ج ر labels.
The intervening focus action moves away from a protected relation before faces reveal divergent outcomes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies covering, relational tether, exposure, and breach; I infer that flight tries to hide from a claim while making the rupture legible. The alternative treats the final labels as verdicts without assigning the focus flight a cover-and-breach mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Flight removes the person from scrutiny and from another's demand.
changed_reading.after: Flight is failed concealment: escaping the brother's tether is itself the visible breach that uncovers the person.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the verbal construction plainly supports flight, while the activated side branch concerns showing teeth and probing hidden contents. It remains anchored in the exact focus root and is sharply reactivated by unveiled, laughing faces and visible teeth in 80:38-39. Downstream prose should present it only as a secondary word-field echo, never translate يَفِرُّ as smiling or baring teeth.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The side branch belongs to يَفِرُّ at focus word 2, and its exposure image converges with the immediately subsequent face sequence.

activation_trace.role: Showing teeth and drawing out hidden contents supplies the anomalous exposure motif inside the flight-root.
Bright disclosure of face or light gives the hidden flight-root image an explicit facial surface.
The tooth visible in laughter precisely reactivates the tooth-exposure detail without replacing the focus verb's syntax.

changed_reading.before: The motion away from the brother only hides or removes the actor.
changed_reading.after: As a contained lexical echo, the flight also bares evidence: the actor's hidden disposition comes out into a later face-and-teeth register.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because ٱلْمَرْءُ grammatically means the person, not food or an esophagus. It remains worth carrying because both embodied branches belong to the exact focus root and the preceding context repeatedly directs the human to food, poured water, growth, and provision. Downstream prose must frame this as an embodied-material activation, not as an alternate lexical translation of ٱلْمَرْءُ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The person-noun at focus word 3 shares its supplied inventory with agreeable food and the bodily passage through which food and drink move.

activation_trace.role: Agreeable, digestible food makes the named person an embodied receiver rather than an abstract social unit.
The throat-to-stomach passage supplies a conduit image for dependence on material intake.
Food as provision and livelihood places the human inside a sustaining economy before the flight.
Delivered water supplies the first intake moving through that economy and bodily conduit.
Useful provision for needs marks the food sequence as ongoing dependence rather than decorative abundance.

changed_reading.before: An autonomous social agent chooses distance from a relative.
changed_reading.after: The fleeing person is also an embodied receiver produced and maintained by flows of provision; his bid for isolation is materially contradicted by the dependence carried in his own root field.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is surprising because restless haste and social confusion are derived side branches rather than the direct verbal sense of flight. It remains anchored in יَفِرُّ through its exact inventory and gains context support when time-pressure and hurry overtake the later faces. Render it as coloring the manner of flight, not as denying purposeful escape.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus verb at word 2 can activate foolish haste and a confused mixture alongside ordinary escape, all inside the severe event-day.

activation_trace.role: The severe occurrence supplies the pressure chamber in which controlled movement can collapse.
Restless lightness and foolish haste color the flight as disordered urgency.
Mixture and confusion expand individual haste into a scene of scrambled social orientation.
Narrow time, hurry, and delay supply the context pressure that makes the anomalous manner plausible.

changed_reading.before: The person selects a clear target and executes a clean escape from it.
changed_reading.after: The event compresses time until escape becomes restless, confused haste: the person knows what bond he leaves but not a stable social direction beyond it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is the most material and form-distant activation: a reported branch of the focus root names a narrow channel in the ground. It remains structurally anchored because poured water, a split earth, and a made-easy path precede the focus, producing a coherent flow analogy. Downstream prose should label it an exploratory material model and must not lexicalize יَفِرُّ as a river or channel.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The flight-root at focus word 2 contains the narrow-ground-channel branch, while the syntax still preserves actual motion away from the brother.

activation_trace.role: A narrow channel in the ground supplies the constrained route through which flight is imagined to flow.
An extended traversable path establishes directed passage as part of the human sequence.
Poured flow supplies the moving material that seeks and occupies a channel.
The earth's forced opening supplies the channel-making rupture.
The tethered brother marks the bank or constraint from which the person is forced into a narrow exit.

changed_reading.before: Flight expresses free selection of any route away from the brother.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, the arriving event ruptures the relational ground and channels the person through the only opening left, making escape feel forced rather than freely routed.

strongest_changes: The opening approach-versus-turning pattern makes 80:34 the universalized endpoint of relational aversion, not an isolated panic image.
The brother's tether branch and the following mother-father-companion-sons sequence recast flight as dismantling a whole architecture of claims and personhood.
The explanatory affair that suffices each person revises the cause of flight into total private occupation rather than danger posed by kin.
The exposure branch of the flight-root, reinforced by sheets, disclosure, and faces, makes attempted escape reveal and record the actor instead of hiding him.
The later residue, overtaking, and constriction branches turn flight into failed escape from consequence even when separation from kin succeeds.
summary.what_was_special: The focus sustains several nonexclusive mechanisms at once: coerced escape from kin, flight from a tethered claim, ethical suspension of humane personhood, resurrection as social reset, sterile rupture against fruitful earth, and paradoxical self-disclosure. The packet's most distinctive activation is that the same flight-root can remain literal while also functioning as probing exposure whose result becomes readable on faces.
remaining_uncertainties: The return-to-beginning, haste, confusion, narrow-channel, and tooth-exposure branches are exact inventory members but form-distant from the focus verb; they should remain exploratory overlays rather than substitutions for flight.

The causal arrows from opening frown to harsh day, from earth-splitting to social rupture, and from record to face are reader-supplied analogies; the packet also permits looser foreshadowing without those arrows.
The brother-as-tether model is lexically strong but may represent a sharpened image of kinship rather than a distinct covenantal claim in the focus construction.
يُغْنِيهِ can activate sufficiency, preoccupation, or both; each supports closure, but they imply different accounts of whether the person feels independent or merely overwhelmed.
